note: BH-10197: in step record (lane.unblock.gh_source), the longest time the queue and review collectors replay a PR's stored GitHub-only answers (reviews, comments, files, head commit time) from its unblock_change_marks row with no new wake and the same head. After it the worker says the PR is due (reason backstop, the worker's own clock) and the reads run again. A value that is not digits 0..86400 is the code fallback 3600. 0 = off: the gate never skips a PR.
